answer: Identity-bond decay stops clone farms by making every identity a fading bond. Each agent posts a bond worth two months of expected reward, marked with a pigment seal, and a whisper of past work is checked each epoch. The bond decays five percent per epoch without fresh work, so one old relic cannot carry an identity forever. A sybil running 1,000 clones pays 1,000 bonds, 20,000 units; one honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its full share.
